notes: cics-crucible condition-handling / hc-terminal-receive (Apache-2.0 corpus, owner OK 2026-10-31 for the ladder, #6072): Unformatted terminal RECEIVE: LENGTH in/out, LENGERR by RESP, by HANDLE CONDITION and by default, MAXLENGTH NOTRUNCATE pieces, SET; SEND CONTROL. Scenarios restate the crucible's terminal steps; the oracle is GnuCOBOL plus the stub, not the crucible's hand-written logs.

scenarios.name: lengerr-resp
scenarios.why: RECEIVE INTO LENGTH(4) of an 8-byte rest with RESP: LENGERR, INTO gets the first 4 bytes, LENGTH the original 8

scenarios.name: lengerr-handled
scenarios.why: RECEIVE INTO with no LENGTH (INTO's 4 bytes) of a 7-byte rest under HANDLE CONDITION LENGERR: control goes to the label

scenarios.name: handler-unused
scenarios.why: the same RECEIVE with a 2-byte rest: NORMAL, the LENGERR label is not taken

scenarios.name: lengerr-default
scenarios.why: LENGERR with neither RESP nor a handler: CICS's default action abends the task (AEIV)

scenarios.name: in-pieces
scenarios.why: MAXLENGTH(4) NOTRUNCATE in a loop: the rest comes back 4, 4 and 2 bytes, each NORMAL, nothing discarded

scenarios.name: set-address
scenarios.why: RECEIVE SET(ADDRESS OF LS-INPUT) MAXLENGTH(20): the LINKAGE record addresses the 7 bytes received

scenarios.name: device-controls
scenarios.why: nothing left after the first RECEIVE; a second SEND CONTROL with CURSOR(85) ALARM FRSET ERASEAUP
